description: This file contains the HTML markup and client-side JavaScript for a database viewer application that allows users to browse tables and data from connected databases.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the server and updates the UI.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables from a selected database and updates the UI.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data from a selected table and populates the content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data in a table format in the specified container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders a cell in the table based on the value.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands a cell to show full content if it was truncated.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays a loading message in the specified element.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message in the specified element.

methods.name: showEmptyState
methods.description: Displays an empty state message in the specified element.

methods.name: setActiveState
methods.description: Sets the active state for a specified element.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches data from a given URL and returns it as JSON.
